sent.description: Follow the link in the email to choose a new password.

resetPassword.heading: Choose a new password
resetPassword.subheading: Make it one you haven't used before
resetPassword.title: Reset Password
resetPassword.description: This signs you out everywhere and signs in nobody — you'll use the new password on the login page.

invalid.subheading: This reset link can't be used

changePassword.warningTitle: Changing your password signs you out everywhere
changePassword.warningBody: All active sessions end, including this one. You'll sign back in with the new password — other devices will need it too.

verifyEmail.heading: Verify your email
verifyEmail.title: Confirm Your Email
verifyEmail.description: This marks your account as verified. It takes one click.
verifyEmail.note: Verification is an engagement signal, not a lock — if this link has expired you can resend it any time from your dashboard.
